description: Edit a contact's name, email or phone (email/phone stored in contact_info). email_bad=true marks the contact's email as bad (bounced, or the wrong person) so mailings skip it, and false clears the mark; email_bad_address limits that to one address when the contact has several. Changing email to a different address clears the mark.

clientId.description: A client's id (from search or list_clients).
